About

Kalyani Forge Ltd is a Pune-
based precision-engineering
company manufacturing hot,
warm, and cold-forged, machined
and assembled components. Its
engine, driveline and axle products
serve passenger /commercial vehicles, agriculture, industrial, power, off-highway, marine and EV applications. Its capabilities include heat treatment, die/tool making,
testing and finishing.[1][2]

Key Points

Business Overview:[1]
KFL supplies forged, fully machined and assembly-ready components using in-house forging, machining, heat treatment, tooling and testing. More than 50% of FY25 revenue came from value-added machining.[2]
